title: Reword Mandate 48: the installed Susi is the stable copy; private debug builds drive development
goal: CEO decision 2026-11-12: drop the clause that the installed production Susi builds its successor. The installed copy is stable, changes only by promotion of a fully qualified release with rollback, and tracks the latest qualified release (falling behind is reported). Development is driven by per-agent private debug builds that never overwrite it. Update Mandate 48 in .agents/identity.json and the matching sentence in AGENTS.md. Text only.
limitations: Text only: nothing yet promotes the installed copy automatically or reports when it falls behind; on 2026-11-12 the installed susi on the CEO's Linux host was 0.21.20 while main was 0.21.65.
A source comment in xtask/src/main.rs still describes the installed release as the toolchain for building the next susi.
